mapper.select: SELECT day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active FROM chat_business_hour ORDER BY day_of_week
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_business_hour (day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active) VALUES (#{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isActive}) AS new_hour ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_time = new_hour.start_time, end_time = new_hour.end_time, is_active = new_hour.is_active
